_comment: The grilling trigger normally lives in AGENTS.md as prose, which is advisory:
measured compliance with policy documents tops out around 36%, and decays
further as a session goes on. Enable this hook if you observe people drifting
past the trigger in long sessions.
Claude Code: merge the `hooks` block below into .claude/settings.json.
VS Code:     copy this file to .github/hooks/grilling-reminder.json (Preview, 1.109+).
Cost of enabling: the rule now lives in two places. Edit one without the other
and the agent is told two different things. Keep them in sync or delete the prose.

hooks.command: node -e "console.log('Before building: if this request adds or alters a design decision - a new module seam, dependency, schema, external contract, agent behaviour, or product rule - run the grill-with-docs skill first. Name the clause that fired, then start. Mechanical work proceeds normally.')"
